known.title: The new read-scope rule of decision 4 has no pending step: steps 1 to 4 are done, and nothing before grid_runs implements target capture, invalidation, or the working-directory warning
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 4 (line 58); Research, Harness facts (line 46); Steps, rows 1-4 dispatch_grid, scorer_report, loop_replay, corpus (status done, lines 80-83) and row 5 grid_runs (line 84)
known.summary: The round-5 edit adds to decision 4 that a run is invalid when a reviewer reads outside its inputs (every tool-call target must be a workspace file, the reviewer's own skill and agent files, a skill:// or artifact:// URI, or a web page outside the benchmark repository; a Grep, Glob, or find call without a path counts as outside), and that every reviewer prompt says the working directory is not the snapshot. But the steps that implement decision 4 and the harness (1 to 4) are already done, and the only later step before the runs, grid_runs, just runs the grid. In the harness at this commit, score.mjs transcriptFacts records no tool-call targets, invalidReasons checks only the model, effort, and tier, and prepare.mjs buildOpening has no working-directory warning. So a correctly configured reviewer that reads the live checkout stays valid, against decision 4. A pending step (or a reopened harness step) must implement the target capture, the invalidation, and the prompt warning before grid_runs.
